card.name: Timing words in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: Words that describe timing or spacing in dosing instructions, such as 'weekly', 'or' in '1-week or longer intervals', 'Weeks' before numbers, 'recently', and 'other' in 'every other day'.

modes.label: Interval wording
modes.description: Frequency or interval words in titration and schedule instructions, just before 'intervals' or 'day'.
modes.example: Dose can be titrated at 1-week<< or>> longer intervals.

modes.label: Time reference words
modes.description: Words giving when something happened or applies, such as 'recently' or 'time' in 'at the time of use'.
modes.example: have<< recently>> been discontinued from an MAOI and started

modes.description: Week or hour words in dosing schedules before a number or a following action.
